name: What is a garage conversion and why should I consider it for my property?

mainEntity.name: What is a garage conversion and why should I consider it for my property?

acceptedAnswer.text: A garage conversion transforms an existing garage into a habitable living space, such as an Accessory Dwelling Unit (ADU), home office, or guest suite. This can significantly increase your property's value and provide additional functional space without the cost or complexity of new construction. Many homeowners in Los Angeles choose garage conversions to generate rental income, accommodate multi-generational living, or expand their usable square footage, especially in areas with limited space for traditional additions.
acceptedAnswer.description: A garage conversion transforms a garage into a living space, increasing property value and providing functional square footage or potential rental income.
